title: Recover repository registry projection after restart
userIntent: Register a secondary repository, restart the candidate, and confirm the public repository list still projects both repositories.

intendedBehavior: The repository-list projection preserves primary and secondary registrations across process restart.
behavioralInvariants: Restart does not rebuild registry state from only the current working directory.
regressionRisks: Persisted registration exists but list projection loses it after reconnect.

provenance.note: Shared restart projection behavior anchored to the exact v1.7.2 release.
